BiblicalUsage: Zibeon is a Hivite chief, the father of Anah and the grandfather of Aholibamah. In Genesis 36:2, Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite. The fuller story is told on the Zibeon profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Zibeon shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
